title: NPDev panel provenance manifest
description: One manifest, three producers (docs/NEXT_EXECUTION_PLAN.md P4.3 / F3): generator-emitted (for AutoPanel/selector-generated panels), agent-emitted (docs/ai/UI_GENERATION_PROMPT.md's required second output), or human-confirmed (bootstrap-panel-provenance-v2.py infers a draft with confirmed:false; a human reviews and flips it to true). The impact gate (F4) enforces only confirmed:true manifests.

panel.description: The panel/screen name. For a generated panel, matches CompiledPanel.name().

screen.description: Repo/app-relative path to the hand-written screen file this manifest describes. Absent for generator-produced panels (there is no separate screen file -- the panel IS the screen).

screenClass.description: F1 taxonomy class (docs/SCREEN_TAXONOMY.md), e.g. operator-console, detail-form. Null until classified.

modelHash.description: The bundle's modelHash (RuntimeMetadataService#schemaFingerprint) this manifest was built against. F4 compares this to the CURRENT app's modelHash to detect drift. NOT required: the generator producer (CompiledMetadataCanonicalJson, which stamps provenance at model-compile time) runs before the schema fingerprint exists -- that fingerprint is computed later, in NPDevGenerator, from the resolved database config (UserDatabaseDefinitionLoader#fingerprintInputs). A generator-producer entry with no modelHash should be treated by F4 as always-re-derive, not stale-compared.

generator.description: Which producer emitted this: a compiler class name (generator), a model id (agent), or the bootstrapper script name (human).

reads.description: Concept.fieldPath entries this screen reads. Every entry must resolve in the bundle's fields catalog -- F4 fails the build otherwise.

invokes.description: invocations[].id entries this screen calls (e.g. 'flow:SubmitExpense', 'panelAction:ExpenseApprovalPanel:SubmitExpense'). Every entry must exist in the bundle's invocations catalog -- F4 fails the build otherwise.

calls.description: Raw HTTP paths observed/declared (method-agnostic string, or 'METHOD path'). Informational -- invokes is the enforced field; calls is evidence for a human reviewing a draft.

slotOf.description: Reserved for ADR-0004's L5 layoutSlot -- the workbench region this panel fills, once that concept ships. Null until then.

confirmed.description: false for every bootstrapper-inferred draft (a hypothesis, not a fact) and true for generator/agent output (confirmed by construction) or a human-reviewed draft. The impact gate (F4) enforces only confirmed:true manifests -- an unconfirmed one is reported, not failed.

unresolved.description: Identifiers the inferring producer could not resolve to a field or invocation. Must be empty before a human sets confirmed:true.

handWritten.description: true when producer is human and the screen is not generated by any NPDev emitter.

reviewedBy.description: Who confirmed this manifest, when producer is human and confirmed is true.
